0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000010_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
0.description: The people of this city have spirit, I'll give them that. They've not lost the will to fight.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000020_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
1.description: I can imagine how torn you must feel, looking at that sky. Knowing what it means to everyone...and that you're responsible.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
3.description: The secrecy is worse. I'd rather people knew.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
4.description: I still can't believe it's coming from me.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000030_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
6.description: If you're thinking of coming clean, don't. It might make <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> feel better, but it would make things a hundred times worse for them. They're better off not knowing.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000040_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
7.description: <sigh> Neither can I, to be honest.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000050_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
8.description: But you heard what the Ascian said: the Light you shine will warp the world around you whether you like it or not. Even Y'shtola and Ryne had to concede that point.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000060_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
9.description: Aye. An all too familiar one. Here you stand alone, expecting no one else to bear the burden for you.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000070_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
10.description: You're in a corner, and there doesn't seem to be any obvious way out.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000080_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
11.description: ...But that doesn't mean it's over. However hopeless it seems, you haven't lost yet.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000090_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
12.description: I remember looking up at the sky like this before─being caught up in a strange kind of calm.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000100_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
13.description: It was after we realized we were responsible for the Flood. When we resolved to journey to the Source by taking our own lives.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000110_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
14.description: One last sacrifice, one last fight...one last failure. And then the Oracle appeared and...well. You know the rest.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000120_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
15.description: There were times in the years and decades that followed when I wondered if we might not've been better off just letting the Rejoining happen.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000130_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
16.description: That we'd made one last mistake...

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000140_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
17.description: But seeing that giant Talos stir to life cured me of any doubts I still had.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000150_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
18.description: Always. Always we took the burden of fighting upon ourselves. That's what heroes do, isn't it?

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000160_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
19.description: So we never had the chance to see anything like that─our people, coming together as one.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000170_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
20.description: To think that their hope still burned so bright...

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000180_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
21.description: ...That they were still so eager to live, they would lift up their fellows, one on top of the other, till they reached the sky.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000190_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
22.description: No, we made the right decision. And I can finally feel proud of the part we played in helping this world survive.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000210_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
24.description: As I thought. What happened between us was no coincidence.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000220_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
25.description: My story may be finished, but the fates have gifted me a minor role in yours.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000230_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
26.description: I suspected as much the moment I realized you could hear me.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000240_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
27.description: But it's hard not to doubt yourself when you're the man who caused the Flood...

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000250_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
28.description: I was afraid to do anything more than watch for fear of making things even worse...

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000260_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
29.description: ...But no longer. After all, the path I once walked is now yours to finish.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000270_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
30.description: For what it's worth, I cast my lot with yours.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000280_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
31.description: If you need a push, I'll be right there behind you; if you lose control, I'll do my best to stop you.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000300_FEOUL
33.description: I was worried you were up here all alone, brooding and fretting and wallowing in your woes. But look at you─grinning at nothing like a pollen-drunk pixie!

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000310_FEOUL
34.description: Hmph! Look at what you've done to your aether! It's a mess! And you have cracks running all through that pretty soul of yours!

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000320_FEOUL
35.description: My poor little sapling. Whatever am I to do with you?

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000330_FEOUL
36.description: Shall I yield up my throne? You could claim it─cut ties with the mortal world, hide away in the castle...

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000340_FEOUL
37.description: It won't fix the problem...but would it really matter? If any pesky heroes come calling with steel and magic, all of Il Mheg will rise up in your defense.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000350_FEOUL
38.description: My crown and scepter are yours...if you want them.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000360_FEOUL
39.description: What? Don't give me that look! Of course I knew before I asked that you'd never ever heed such a <hex:021A020203>wicked<hex:021A020103> suggestion!

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000370_FEOUL
40.description: And besides, what would become of my precious and ephemeral flower?

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000380_FEOUL
41.description: My dear, beloved sapling. You are lost─confused─and have precious little time to gather your wits.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000390_FEOUL
42.description: Your kind is always so preoccupied with what lies ahead, and so we muddle your vision with fog and glamour. But such trickery is easy to see through.

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000400_FEOUL
43.description: Stand very, very still. Think not of where you need to go, but where you are right now at this moment. At this time, in this place...

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000410_FEOUL
44.description: Our [friend] of crystal. From shadowed hood he watched you go, his ruby eyes with warmth aglow.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000420_FEOUL
45.description: See yourself as he saw you, and that shall be the clearest clue.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000430_FEOUL
46.description: You stand in his garden, dear sapling. Ask his flowers what they know, and you will surely find an answer.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000440_FEOUL
47.description: But what will you do with it, I wonder...? I'll be watching and waiting, waiting and watching!

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000450_LYNA
48.description: I have unlocked the door to the Umbilicus. You are free to enter.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000460_LYNA
49.description: Once you have what you require, I'll see it sealed once more. Until then, I will remain without.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000470_URIANGER
50.description: A moment to collect my thoughts, I prithee...

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000480_URIANGER
51.description: Thy true name is G'raha Tia, then.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000490_URIANGER
52.description: By thy claims, thou too art a native of the Source, though from an age beyond our own, when the Eighth Umbral Calamity hath visited devastation upon our star.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000500_URIANGER
53.description: Thou hast, by subtle means, reached across the boundaries of time and space to unsow the seeds of catastrophe, ere its creeping vines drag our champion unto an early grave...

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000510_MYSTERYVOICE
54.description: In essence, yes. A difficult story to swallow, I am sure...

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000530_URIANGER
56.description: I doubt not the veracity of thy words─not the account of thy coming, nor that of the fated Calamity.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000540_URIANGER
57.description: Yet my mind straineth still to apprehend the enormity of this tale. Wouldst thou favor me with a gradual unfolding of its chapters?

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000551_MYSTERYVOICE
59.description: But where to begin? I should start with those great minds who survived the Calamity─Cid Garlond being perhaps the greatest.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000560_MYSTERYVOICE
60.description: In hopes of staying the unending tides of war, he and his fellows pursued all manner of possible solutions.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000570_MYSTERYVOICE
61.description: One of these was rooted in a theory which unified several fundamental principles discovered over the course of the Warrior of Light's adventures.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000580_MYSTERYVOICE
62.description: It proposed a method by which one could enter the river of time, traverse the rift, and leap between worlds.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000590_MYSTERYVOICE
63.description: Perfecting that idea, however, was a work which consumed their lifetimes. And thus was it left to future generations to decide whether theory would be put into practice.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000600_MYSTERYVOICE
64.description: But all the while the world continued to burn. Hope was a feeble outpost, beset on all sides by thievery and misery and murder.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000610_MYSTERYVOICE
65.description: People cried out in despair, “There is no hope. We are finished. <hex:021A020203>Mankind<hex:021A020103> is finished.”

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000620_MYSTERYVOICE
66.description: Then others raised their voices in answer.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000630_MYSTERYVOICE
67.description: "Though we be beyond salvation, those who came before may yet be saved.“

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000640_MYSTERYVOICE
68.description: "We will forge a crossroads, and pave the way for a different future. By the wisdom of our forebears we will prevent this Calamity from ever having come to pass.“

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000650_MYSTERYVOICE
69.description: The fighting went on unabated, but some few took up Cid's research, and labored to realize those impossible ideas.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000660_MYSTERYVOICE
70.description: After two centuries of labor, their descendants finally succeeded in awakening the Crystal Tower─an integral part of the process─and in doing so roused its caretaker. Me.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000670_MYSTERYVOICE
71.description: By this stage, scholars had largely established the phenomena underpinning the Rejoining, and identified the First as the shard which precipitated the Eighth Umbral Calamity.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000680_MYSTERYVOICE
72.description: This grand structure was already capable of storing the energies required to attempt the translocation. All that remained was to augment some few of its functions, based upon the theoretical models of Cid and his compeers.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000690_URIANGER
73.description: And by means of such technologies didst thou effect thine arrival in the First, to an age before this star had joined with the Source.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000700_MYSTERYVOICE
74.description: Some while before, as it turned out. 'Tis all but impossible to predict how time will flow between one world and the next, and we missed our mark by almost an entire century.

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000710_MYSTERYVOICE
75.description: But this only worked in our favor. The sin eaters could not be defeated without the blessing of Light, and summoning the only man who might stand a chance against them would require decades of preparation.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000720_MYSTERYVOICE
76.description: But this only worked in our favor. The sin eaters could not be defeated without the blessing of Light, and summoning the only woman who might stand a chance against them would require decades of preparation.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000730_URIANGER
77.description: ...An undertaking of scarce credible endurance. That thou hast kept thy plan from falling into disarray these many years bordereth on the miraculous.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000740_URIANGER
78.description: Yet howsoever history be rewritten, thy present self was shaped by events which followed the Calamity.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000750_URIANGER
79.description: Should said catastrophe be averted, the very skein of thine existence will unravel. Surely thou hast foreseen this...

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000760_MYSTERYVOICE
80.description: I am aware of the consequences. 'Tis for that very reason Cid and his colleagues bequeathed their legacy as an offering...and not an edict.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000770_MYSTERYVOICE
81.description: To give all of oneself for the happiness of others, and with no promise of reward? 'Tis a hard thing to ask.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000780_MYSTERYVOICE
82.description: Harder still for those condemned to survive in a world which pitted brother against brother. Indeed, you were right to call the execution of this plan “miraculous”─though the force which held it together was nothing so inexplicable.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000790_MYSTERYVOICE
83.description: It was him. The Warrior of Light has been our unbroken thread.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000800_MYSTERYVOICE
84.description: It was her. The Warrior of Light has been our unbroken thread.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000810_MYSTERYVOICE
85.description: Where others would stumble and fall, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> would rise above. Where others would break and run, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> would carry on.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000820_MYSTERYVOICE
86.description: The Warrior of Light's tale is one of unyielding bravery. To tell it was to feel courage; to hear it was to feel hope. It was a breath of inspiration in an age of suffocating shadow.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000830_MYSTERYVOICE
87.description: In the histories of a fallen nation was our hero hailed as its greatest ally.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000840_MYSTERYVOICE
88.description: In the timeworn pages of a noble's memoirs were <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> deeds joyously retold.

89.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000850_MYSTERYVOICE
89.description: For many, these stories were the flame which warmed them through the coldest of nights.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000860_MYSTERYVOICE
90.description: And so it should come as little surprise that the plan found no shortage of volunteers, concerning as it did the Warrior of Light <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603>. It was their chance to add their own verse to the hero's saga.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000870_MYSTERYVOICE
91.description: He was the lodestar that brought them all together, to send their final message back through time and space...to him.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000880_MYSTERYVOICE
92.description: She was the lodestar that brought them all together, to send their final message back through time and space...to her.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000890_MYSTERYVOICE
93.description: "The light of your legacy was our torch in the darkness. Burn bright again...and live.“

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000900_MYSTERYVOICE
94.description: I am merely the bearer of that wish, come to ensure it is safely delivered.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000910_URIANGER
95.description: Wherefore sharest thou this burden with me and no other? What wouldst thou have me say?

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000920_MYSTERYVOICE
96.description: That you will be my accomplice?

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000930_MYSTERYVOICE
97.description: 'Twas you yourself who convinced me of your suitability when you spoke of how you learned of the Flood, and of your part in arranging Minfilia's journey to the First.

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000940_MYSTERYVOICE
98.description: Your actions showed uncommon resolve. 'Twas clear you were committed to the cause of saving this world.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000950_MYSTERYVOICE
99.description: I knew I could trust you to choose the right path forward...even if that choice came with a heavy price.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000970_MYSTERYVOICE
101.description: When all is said and done, and the last of the Lightwardens lies slain, I will absorb their corrupted aether. And then I will die.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000980_MYSTERYVOICE
102.description: Knowing what I know of your companions─not to mention your champion─they will try to stop me.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_000990_MYSTERYVOICE
103.description: But in saving one they would save none.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001000_MYSTERYVOICE
104.description: Therefore I implore you to aid me in concealing my identity, and ensuring this tale ends as it must.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001010_MYSTERYVOICE
105.description: To this end, I would have you take what I have told you of the Calamity and make of it a portent─a prophetic vision you beheld in the swirling chaos of the rift.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001030_MYSTERYVOICE
107.description: History remembered the Warrior of Light, as I knew it would. And I will suffer no other to rescue the champion whose star has charted my course.

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001040_MYSTERYVOICE
108.description: At this point in time, I yet travel with the Warrior of Light in Eorzea. And I would not have matters here interfere with that of all episodes in my life.

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001050_MYSTERYVOICE
109.description: At this point in time, the Warrior of Light and I have yet to meet in Eorzea. And I would not wish that meeting soured by events which happen here.

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001060_MYSTERYVOICE
110.description: I will see this tale to a happy end, my friend. There has been enough tragedy.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001080_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
112.description: If you lose control again, the Light could claim you for good.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001090_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
113.description: Although it's probably only a matter of time before you succumb to the change, in any case.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001100_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
114.description: What do you mean to do?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
116.description: I mean to hunt down Emet-Selch.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
117.description: I mean to rescue the Exarch.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
118.description: I mean to have a few words...with both Emet and the Exarch.

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001120_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
120.description: Then we should be on our way. The Ascian mentioned the Tempest, did he not?

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001130_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
121.description: That's “the stormy seas around Kholusia” to you. His lair must be down there somewhere, hidden beneath the waves.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001150_URIANGER
123.description: Word reached us of thy recovery, and thus did we gather with all haste.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001160_URIANGER
124.description: Ah. By thy looks, I gather thou hast gleaned that which I came to tell thee.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001170_ALPHINAUD
125.description: Urianger has shared everything with us─the Exarch's true identity and purpose.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001190_URIANGER
127.description: When I agreed to aid the Exarch with his plans, 'twas in full acceptance of the condemnation I would face when my duplicity was laid bare.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001200_URIANGER
128.description: ...Yet it is not rancor but resolve that I sense in thee. Thou art fully intent upon walking thy path to its end, art thou not?

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001210_URIANGER
129.description: If thou canst forgive my deception─or, failing that, set aside thy displeasure for a time─I do beg leave to follow thee. What strength and wisdom I possess are thine to command.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
132.description: I am a danger to those around me.

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001220_URIANGER
134.description: ...I thank thee. Doubt not but that I will do all in my power to repay thy kindness, and fulfill the Exarch's wishes.

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001230_URIANGER
135.description: I understand the precarious nature of thy condition. Nonetheless, it is my wish to remain at thy side for as long as I am able.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001240_URIANGER
136.description: Pray believe me when I say that I took no pleasure in deceiving thee. Indeed, I curse the circumstances which compelled me to do so... But no further secrets lie between us, I swear it.

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001250_RYNE
137.description: I'm sorry but...I don't think this is a good idea.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001260_RYNE
138.description: Leaving the Crystarium, I mean─with or without Urianger.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001270_RYNE
139.description: What I did for you won't last forever. There's no telling when the Light will break free again.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001280_RYNE
140.description: Please, you must stay here, at least for a little while longer! We will find a way to cure this, I promise you!

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001290_ALISAIE
141.description: How can you make promises!? We don't even know where to start!

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001300_ALPHINAUD
142.description: Alisaie, please. You know Ryne was only trying to help.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001310_ALISAIE
143.description: Of course I know! I know only too well!

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001320_ALISAIE
144.description: But making promises you have no way of keeping is not a kindness─it's a lie, plain and simple!

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001330_ALISAIE
145.description: We've all searched high and low for an answer! And every one of us came back empty-handed!

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001340_ALISAIE
146.description: I am not about to stand in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> way now─not after failing <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468696D03> in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> hour of need! No, the least we can do is...

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001350_ALPHINAUD
147.description: We will go with you, as well.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001360_ALPHINAUD
148.description: There is naught to be gained by standing still.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001370_YSHTOLA
149.description: Indeed, we have exhausted every other avenue.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001380_YSHTOLA
150.description: Lead and we shall follow. If there <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> any hope to be found, then we will surely find it at your side.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001400_CASSARD
152.description: (-???-)Is there aught we can do to help?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001410_KATLISS
153.description: Though we may not know the whole story, we do know you're in for a fight.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001420_KATLISS
154.description: And while the Exarch's away, it falls to the rest of us to see the Warrior of Darkness is given a proper send-off!

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001440_LYNA
156.description: No! Well...not in so many words.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001450_GLYNARD
157.description: Aye, we didn't need it spelled out for us. When the night sky appeared over whichever place you went to, it was harder <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> to put two and two together!

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001460_BRAGI
158.description: From the moment I heard that you and the Exarch shared a homeland, I had my suspicions.

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001470_BRAGI
159.description: Long had he been waiting for a certain someone to arrive...and I knew at once that it must be you.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001480_CRYSTARIUMGATEKEEPER
160.description: Exactly! When he went out to meet you, 'twas clear it was no ordinary visitor.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001490_CRYSTARIUMGATEKEEPER
161.description: That spring in his step spoke volumes. I could feel his excitement!

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001530_MOREN
165.description: We do not fully understand where you or the Exarch hail from, or why you've all done so much to protect us.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001540_MOREN
166.description: But we are deeply grateful, nonetheless.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001550_MOREN
167.description: So if there is anything at all we might do to aid your journey, you need only name it. What would you have of us?

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001560_YSHTOLA
168.description: You might have invited them to join us, were there not so many. But come, they are waiting. What is your will, O Warrior of Darkness?

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
170.description: Defend the Crystarium until we return!

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A4_000_002_NONE_VOICE
171.description: Leave it to us─we'll see the Exarch home safe and sound!

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A4_000_003_NONE_VOICE
172.description: Hope for the best, but prepare for the worst...

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001580_BISMARCK
174.description: (-Bismarck-)[Long has it been since my name was called.]

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001590_BISMARCK
175.description: (-Bismarck-)[Why do you wake me, little neighbor?]

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001600_URIANGER
176.description: [To the bottom of the western sea we go. Pray lend us your back and your breath.]

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001620_BISMARCK
178.description: (-Bismarck-)[This world is in twilight. I wait for the sun to set. I wish only to sleep.]

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001630_ALISAIE
179.description: Oh dear. I don't need to speak Fae to know that didn't go well...

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001641_FEOUL
184.description: My [adorable sapling]! You've learned to call me at last!

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001650_FEOUL
185.description: And where do you go? On a trip? A journey? I <hex:021A020203>knew<hex:021A020103> you wouldn't give up without a fight!

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001660_FEOUL
186.description: Oh, my precious mortal. I shall help you in any way I can!

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001670_FEOUL
187.description: [Sleepy Bismarck, you old pixie! These are my precious, precious saplings.]

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001680_FEOUL
188.description: [Let their wish be the king's command.]

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001700_BISMARCK
190.description: (-Bismarck-)[What a rare thing to awaken to.]

191.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001710_BISMARCK
191.description: (-Bismarck-)[My beautiful king. If it be thy wish, then so shall it be done.]

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001720_FEOUL
192.description: Be sure to scrub this one's teeth for him upon your return. It's only good manners.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001730_URIANGER
193.description: It will be done, Your Majesty. Our deepest thanks for your timely intervention.

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001740_FEOUL
194.description: An agreement is reached, and your departure is at hand! You wingless ones best hold on tight!

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001750_FEOUL
195.description: May the blessings of the fae keep you safe, [shining souls]!

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001760_BISMARCK
196.description: (-Bismarck-)[To the western sea we go. Wrapped in my breath, I will see you to your destination, little neighbors.]

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001770_IRVITHE
197.description: And just like that, it's all gone back to the way it was...

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001780_GRITHIL
198.description: What was you expecting? Hundred years of honey and rainbows?

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001790_GRITHIL
199.description: Seeing them Eulmore types wake up and smell the ashes was miracle enough for me.

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001800_IRVITHE
200.description: Ah, but the magic in the air when that Ladder started moving...hah! And when that great hulking Talos rose up, <hex:021A020203>gods<hex:021A020103>...

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001810_IRVITHE
201.description: I could live a thousand years and never behold anything so amazing...

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001820_GRITHIL
202.description: What the─! Do you see that!?

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001830_IRVITHE
203.description: What a monster! Where did it even come from!?

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001870_BISMARCK
207.description: (-Bismarck-)[I have fulfilled my duty. I return now to the lake.]

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001880_BISMARCK
208.description: (-Bismarck-)[I have not flown in an age. It was...pleasant. May your journey be a safe one, little neighbors.]

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001900_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
210.description: The breath of Bismarck. See how it swells to form a dome beneath the waves...

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001910_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
211.description: The waters recede. The Tempest's floor is laid bare.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001920_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
212.description: In defiance of the blinding sky, this place holds fast to its gloom.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001930_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
213.description: The last refuge of he who denies the Light with every fiber of his being.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001940_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
214.description: You stand at the precipice, hero. Journey unto the Heart of Darkness. Finish it.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001950_READEROFONDO
215.description: O stewards of the Ondo... We offer up our light in answer...

216.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001960_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
216.description: That crystal you showed the artisan...

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001970_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
217.description: Was it...? Did it belong to one of my friends?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A6_000_001_NONE_VOICE
219.description: I thought you were always watching?

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001980_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
221.description: I try to give you a <hex:021A020203>measure<hex:021A020103> of privacy... No one wants a spirit looking over their shoulder every moment of the day.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_001990_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
222.description: So tell me, if you would. How did you come across that crystal?

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002060_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
229.description: Strange that I should learn such things now, after they're long gone. They were fine friends, every one of them...

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002070_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
230.description: I didn't expect death to teach me so much.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002080_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
231.description: About them, about Seto─about you. About the hope that hides at the heart of this world.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002090_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
232.description: I've never been one for idle chitchat, but if by some miracle I could see them all again, I doubt I'd ever stop talking...

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002100_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
233.description: I'm grateful I got to bend your ear, at least. And just for that, I reckon I'll stick with you...to the very end.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002110_ALPHINAUD
234.description: Apologies─we were a little late to the gathering.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002120_YSHTOLA
235.description: It seems we've succeeded in gaining their trust.

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002130_THANCRED
236.description: The delay wasn't exactly welcome, but at least our many hands made light work.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002140_THANCRED
237.description: And they seemed especially impressed with your contribution. Our hero, indeed.

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002150_ALPHINAUD
238.description: Y'shtola was telling us those structures may date back to the age of the Ascians.

240.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002170_ALISAIE
240.description: Despite his many protestations, I never quite believed Emet-Selch was telling the truth.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002180_ALPHINAUD
241.description: Nor I. But there is no denying the evidence before our eyes. Clearly, this was once a great city...

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002190_ALPHINAUD
242.description: ...A home they would see restored, no matter how many tens of thousands of years it takes.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002200_ALISAIE
243.description: It's a hollow dream, when you think about it. Even if they manage to rejoin all the worlds, they'll never bring back the ones who were lost.

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002210_ALISAIE
244.description: But would I have done any different...?

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002220_RYNE
245.description: Are you...? How are you feeling?

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002240_READEROFONDO
247.description: Yesss... To the honored ancientsss have we offered up our prayers and our gratitude. You, too, have our thanks.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002250_URIANGER
248.description: Might we trouble thee then to tell us more of the illuminated land of which thou didst lately speak?

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002260_READEROFONDO
249.description: To the west of here lies a great trench. Some days ago, a light appeared in that endlesss darknesss.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002270_READEROFONDO
250.description: Curiousss, we ventured closer...and discovered in the depths an entire city.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002280_READEROFONDO
251.description: The buildings we spied were akin to our own everlasting abodes. Impossibly so.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002290_READEROFONDO
252.description: We understood at once─the ancients had risen. There could be no doubt.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002300_READEROFONDO
253.description: Taken with terror, we retreated to the Cupsss, and I decreed that none should enter the trench until such time as we received a sssign.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002310_ALPHINAUD
254.description: Might it still be possible to reach this city of the ancients?

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002320_READEROFONDO
255.description: Hm... With no water to drown you, a finless one could now travel there, yesss.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002330_READEROFONDO
256.description: I am convinced you are the sssign for which we have been waiting. My people will show you the way.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002360_ALPHINAUD
259.description: When the Ondo spoke of a city, I did not think they meant an actual city!

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002370_YSHTOLA
260.description: Then...we are seeing the same view.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002380_YSHTOLA
261.description: The remnants in the Ondo settlement were solid, material structures, but these...

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002390_YSHTOLA
262.description: Everything here pulses with aether. 'Tis an enchantment on a monumental scale!

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002400_EMETSELCH
263.description: This really is unacceptable. I gave you very specific instructions.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002420_EMETSELCH
265.description: My invitation was for an abomination, ripe with the power to bring about the world's annihilation.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002430_EMETSELCH
266.description: Not this half-broken...thing. Whatever am I to do with you?

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002440_EMETSELCH
267.description: And I see you insist on keeping the same familiar company. Are you so lost without them?

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002450_YSHTOLA
268.description: It is not <hex:021A020203><hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503><hex:021A020103> who is lost without the familiar.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002460_YSHTOLA
269.description: Not content with remaking an entire city, you aim to fill it with the reconstituted souls of the dead.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002470_EMETSELCH
270.description: I may have gotten a <hex:021A020203>little<hex:021A020103> carried away, in my attention to detail. Added a few unnecessary flourishes...

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002480_EMETSELCH
271.description: Weeell, there's no point trying to hide it. Yes.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002490_EMETSELCH
272.description: Once the rejoining of worlds is complete, Zodiark will regain His full strength and shatter His prison.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002500_EMETSELCH
273.description: Then we shall offer up the Source's remaining inhabitants in sacrifice, that we might resurrect our brethren who died to bring Zodiark into existence.

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002510_EMETSELCH
274.description: But what was it that <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> came here to do, exactly?

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A7_000_001_NONE_VOICE
276.description: We came here to stop you.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A7_000_002_NONE_VOICE
277.description: We came here for the Exarch.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002520_EMETSELCH
278.description: Did you now? One last do-or-die attempt to foil my plans before your mind dissolves into madness?

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002540_EMETSELCH
280.description: In every single age, there is always <hex:021A020203>someone<hex:021A020103> who wants to stand up to the evil Ascians.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002550_EMETSELCH
281.description: Always the same arrogance, the same insistence that the world belongs to them. As if theirs were the only rightful claim, theirs the only existence worthy of preservation!

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002560_EMETSELCH
282.description: Well, you can't have him. The wisdom that man guards may open up new worlds of possibilities.

283.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002570_EMETSELCH
283.description: He has unlocked the secrets of travel across the rift─and through time as well, it would seem. Quite an accomplishment for one of his “incomplete” nature.

284.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002580_EMETSELCH
284.description: I must explore the limits of his capabilities, and harness that power for the Ardor.

285.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002590_EMETSELCH
285.description: Even now, after everything, you refuse to see reason.

286.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002600_EMETSELCH
286.description: You think it unfair that you are subject to suffering? That your lives will be sacrificed for the ancients?

287.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002610_EMETSELCH
287.description: Look at me! I have lived a thousand <hex:021A020203>thousand<hex:021A020103> of your lives!

288.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002620_EMETSELCH
288.description: I have broken bread with you, fought with you, grown ill, grown old! Sired children and yes, welcomed death's sweet embrace.

289.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002630_EMETSELCH
289.description: For eons have I measured your worth and found you wanting! Too weak and feeble-minded to serve as stewards of any star!

290.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002640_EMETSELCH
290.description: Have your recent spats with Vauthry and his sin eaters taught you nothing?

291.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002650_EMETSELCH
291.description: Have you not learned that your ignorance and frailty beget only endless misery?

292.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002660_EMETSELCH
292.description: How long do you mean to perpetuate this farce? How much more must I endure your bumbling interference?

293.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002670_EMETSELCH
293.description: Let us imagine that the laws of reality are again undone, and the world faces true annihilation. Do you honestly believe that half your number would sacrifice themselves to save the other?

295.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002690_EMETSELCH
295.description: And if <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> had witnessed history unfold as <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> have, you would reach the <hex:021A020203>same<hex:021A020103> conclusion!

296.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002700_EMETSELCH
296.description: You cannot be entrusted with our legacy.

297.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002710_EMETSELCH
297.description: I will bring back our brethren. Our friends. Our loved ones. The world belongs to us and us alone.

299.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002730_ALPHINAUD
299.description: We understand. Truly. But it makes no difference.

300.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002740_ALPHINAUD
300.description: The ones you love are in the past.

301.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002750_ALPHINAUD
301.description: While ours are here in the present.

302.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002760_ALPHINAUD
302.description: One day, we too will be ashes and dust, but not today. Our time is not yet finished.

303.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002770_ALPHINAUD
303.description: We share your conviction...and that is why we will not abandon our course.

304.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002780_EMETSELCH
304.description: You think us the same? You think your tattered soul of equal worth to those <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> lost?

305.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002790_EMETSELCH
305.description: Then come─<hex:021A020203>earn<hex:021A020103> your place. Prove yourselves <hex:021A020203>worthy<hex:021A020103> to inherit this star.

306.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002800_EMETSELCH
306.description: Behold, the coming oblivion. 'Twas the end of our era, and the beginning of our great work.

307.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002810_EMETSELCH
307.description: A fitting backdrop...for your final judgment.

308.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002820_EMETSELCH
308.description: I shall wait within, but do not spend too much time on your preparations. There's no telling how much longer the guest of honor will last.

313.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002850_EMETSELCH
313.description: Your performance was underwhelming, and I remain unconvinced of your worthiness.

314.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002860_EMETSELCH
314.description: Oh, you tower over your misbegotten ilk, no doubt. But should I bring my full strength to bear, well...you would be as leaves in the wind.

315.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002870_EMETSELCH
315.description: The gulf between us is a reflection of the disparity between the world as it was...and what it has become.

318.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002900_ALISAIE
318.description: Our worlds may not live up to your lofty standards...

319.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002910_ALISAIE
319.description: But they are <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> worlds! <hex:021A020203>Our<hex:021A020103> homes! Full of life and love and hope!

320.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002920_ALISAIE
320.description: And we won't stand by and let you destroy them!

324.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002960_EMETSELCH
324.description: For we who have known perfection, the shattered Source and these shards are ghastly mockeries of the true world.

325.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002970_EMETSELCH
325.description: The ephemeral lives you exalt are pale imitations, utterly devoid of meaning.

326.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002980_ALPHINAUD
326.description: Belittle us all you like, but we will rise again and again, and give the lie to your insults through word and deed.

327.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_002990_ALPHINAUD
327.description: <hex:021A020203>We<hex:021A020103> define our worth, not the circumstances of our creation!

329.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003010_EMETSELCH
329.description: Fool. Who are you? No one. <hex:021A020203>Nothing<hex:021A020103>.

330.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003020_EMETSELCH
330.description: Once I have reclaimed my heritage, my first act will be to expunge your stain from history's weave.

331.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003030_EMETSELCH
331.description: My world will have no need for heroes.

333.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003050_YSHTOLA
333.description: It is true that all we hold dear is fated to fade away.

334.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003060_YSHTOLA
334.description: But that is no reason for us to forsake it!

335.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003070_URIANGER
335.description: To take what steps we may, and thus mark the road for those who would follow.

336.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003080_URIANGER
336.description: To strive for the best of all futures... Be this not also thy purpose!?

337.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003090_EMETSELCH
337.description: Do not presume to speak of <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> future!

338.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003100_EMETSELCH
338.description: And <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>! Why waste your final moments in futile defiance?

339.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003110_EMETSELCH
339.description: Weary wanderer─you've no fight left to fight! No life left to live!

340.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003120_EMETSELCH
340.description: Hah hah hah hah hah! You see! The Light will not be denied!

341.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003130_EMETSELCH
341.description: Surrender to your fate, and let the transformation take you!

342.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003140_EMETSELCH
342.description: Rise up in madness and fury! Devour the vermin infesting the land which is rightfully ours!

346.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003180_RYNE
346.description: Fight it... You have to hold on!

347.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003190_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
347.description: If you had the strength to take another step, could you do it?

353.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003220_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
353.description: Take it. We fight as one!

354.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003230_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
354.description: This world is not yours to end...

355.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003240_WARRIOROFDARKNESS
355.description: This is our future. Our story.

357.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003260_EMETSELCH
357.description: Bah, a trick of the light. You are a broken husk, nothing more.

358.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003270_EMETSELCH
358.description: How can you hope to stand against me alone?

360.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003290_EMETSELCH
360.description: How did─!? ...I'm surprised you can stand at all.

361.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003300_MYSTERYVOICE
361.description: I could not well leave matters half-finished.

362.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003310_MYSTERYVOICE
362.description: Let expanse contract, eon become instant!

363.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003320_MYSTERYVOICE
363.description: Champions from beyond the rift, heed my call!

367.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A9_000_002_NONE_VOICE
367.description: It ends this day. One way or another, it ends.

368.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003340_EMETSELCH
368.description: Very well. Let us proceed to your final judgment.

369.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003350_EMETSELCH
369.description: The victor shall write the tale, and the vanquished become its villain!

370.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003360_EMETSELCH
370.description: But come! Let us cast aside titles and pretense, and reveal our true faces to one another!

371.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003370_EMETSELCH
371.description: I am Hades! He who shall awaken our brethren from their dark slumber!

373.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003390_EMETSELCH
373.description: Should I surrender this fight, what will become of it all...?

374.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003400_EMETSELCH
374.description: What will become of our triumphs? Our hopes? Our...our despair?

375.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003410_EMETSELCH
375.description: What of this anguish which yet burns in my breast even after the passing of eons?

376.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003420_EMETSELCH
376.description: No, no, no! I will not let it all be for naught!

382.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003480_URIANGER
382.description: Now! Strike with all thy might!

385.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003510_ALPHINAUD
385.description: It's over. Emet-Selch is no more!

388.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003540_YSHTOLA
388.description: His aether... It is...it is as it used to be.

389.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003550_YSHTOLA
389.description: Her aether... It is...it is as it used to be.

390.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003560_YSHTOLA
390.description: As a disciple of Zodiark, the Ascian was the Darkness to your Light...

391.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003570_YSHTOLA
391.description: I can but assume that when you set your strength against his, the Light within you was spent.

393.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003590_RYNE
393.description: Under the strain of that incredible flood of aether, your soul had begun to break apart. Yet now it seems somehow...restored.

394.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003600_RYNE
394.description: I tried to help you before the battle, but Emet-Selch stopped me. So, h-how did you─exactly what did you... Can you tell us what happened?

396.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A10_000_001_NONE_VOICE
396.description: I had help from a hero of this world...

397.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A10_000_002_NONE_VOICE
397.description: I'll explain it all another time...

400.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003630_MYSTERYVOICE
400.description: I believe I owe you all an apology. And you most especially.

402.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A11_000_001_NONE_VOICE
402.description: Let's get out of here first!

403.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A11_000_002_NONE_VOICE
403.description: I'm tired─we'll leave the lecture for later.

404.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_A11_000_003_NONE_VOICE
404.description: 'Tis good to see you awake, G'raha Tia.

408.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003660_CHAINUZZ
408.description: So, those mad souls dove straight into the ocean over there, did they?

409.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003670_IRVITHE
409.description: Ah, a-all I could see from here was the whale, Master Chai...

410.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003680_DULIACHAI
410.description: 'Twas surely Alphinaud and those friends of his! They did something <hex:021A020203>heroic<hex:021A020103>, mark my words!

411.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003690_DULIACHAI
411.description: You need only look up there for proof of that!

413.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003710_CHAINUZZ
413.description: They're sure to be back─any moment now. Any moment...

414.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003720_DULIACHAI
414.description: They are coming back, aren't they? I couldn't bear the thought of...of...

416.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003740_CHAINUZZ
416.description: There, there, dear. Everything will be all right...

417.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003750_GRITHIL
417.description: There! There! Look, over there! Over at the beach!

422.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003800_ALPHINAUD
422.description: I didn't think...we'd be swimming...the <hex:021A020203>whole<hex:021A020103> way back...

428.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003860_YSHTOLA
428.description: He'll wash up sooner or later.

431.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003890_MYSTERYVOICE
431.description: And thus did salvation come to the First.

432.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003900_MYSTERYVOICE
432.description: The lamps of Amaurot will fade along with Emet-Selch's enchantments, and the depths shall be as once they were.

433.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003910_MYSTERYVOICE
433.description: Mt. Gulg will one day fall, and the Talos below yield to wind and rain.

434.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003920_MYSTERYVOICE
434.description: This tale, too, will fade with time, passing into legend as the world heals and moves on.

436.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003940_MYSTERYVOICE
436.description: As aether obeys the cycle─as death and decay gives way to new life...

437.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003950_MYSTERYVOICE
437.description: So too do the memories we share inspire others to rise to greatness.

438.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003960_MYSTERYVOICE
438.description: For we who walk before may lead those who walk after.

439.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003970_MYSTERYVOICE
439.description: Your road goes ever on, as does your story. As does your legacy.

440.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003980_MYSTERYVOICE
440.description: Such is the hero's lot─to touch the lives of countless others...

441.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_003990_NEXTHEROBOY
441.description: Excuse me! You're the Warrior of Darkness...aren't you?

442.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004000_NEXTHEROBOY
442.description: Where are you from, really? And how did you get to be so strong!?

443.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004010_NEXTHEROBOY
443.description: Where are you from, really? And how did you get to be so strong!?

444.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004020_MYSTERYVOICE
444.description: By your deeds has the blinding Light been banished from these skies, and the sin eaters driven to retreat.

445.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004030_MYSTERYVOICE
445.description: Although our many hurts will be years in the mending, I have faith that this world and her people will one day be whole once more.

446.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004040_MYSTERYVOICE
446.description: With no Rejoining in prospect, the Source need no longer fear the coming of an Eighth Umbral Calamity.

447.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004050_YSHTOLA
447.description: And with that triumph, the future from which you came will no longer come to pass... Yet, here you still stand.

448.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004060_MYSTERYVOICE
448.description: ...So I do. I wonder if that other age continues onward somehow, cut adrift from time's flow? Or have I simply etched myself a place upon this new block of history?

449.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004070_MYSTERYVOICE
449.description: Either way, this is an unexpected development.

450.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004080_MYSTERYVOICE
450.description: As the summoner of your souls, my death was meant to release you back to your world.

451.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004090_MYSTERYVOICE
451.description: Yet I am very much alive, and you are still stuck here in the First.

452.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004100_ALPHINAUD
452.description: I believe I speak for us all when I say that we are happy to postpone our return if it means your life is spared. We will seek out another way.

453.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004110_ALISAIE
453.description: Besides, I never had any intention of rushing home. There are people here I still need to thank, and this means I might actually have time to do so.

454.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004120_URIANGER
454.description: Yet we dare not neglect our comrades in the Source.

455.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004130_URIANGER
455.description: Mistress Tataru, to name but one, will be most anxious to know how things stand with us.

456.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004140_THANCRED
456.description: So─you'll just have to make the journey alone for the moment. Be sure and give a full report to our fellow Scions, would you? Oh, and we'd also appreciate any news you can bring us from back home.

457.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004150_MYSTERYVOICE
457.description: Then I see no reason to delay. I can open the path from here.

458.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004160_YSHTOLA
458.description: I imagine we each have matters demanding our attention, so let this be a farewell for us all.

459.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004170_YSHTOLA
459.description: Send word when you've resummoned our friend.

460.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004180_YSHTOLA
460.description: Oh, and do try to ensure <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> arrives <hex:021A020203>within<hex:021A020103> the city next time.

461.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004190_MYSTERYVOICE
461.description: Hah! Of course! I shall strive for utmost accuracy! No strange forests or unplanned passengers, I promise.

462.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004200_RYNE
462.description: I'm a little relieved, to be honest. I would have been terribly lonely if everyone had suddenly disappeared...

463.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004210_RYNE
463.description: But I understand that you have to go. Safe journey, Warrior of Darkness. I hope to see you again soon!

464.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004220_MYSTERYVOICE
464.description: Just a moment while I attune the portal, then you can be on your way.

465.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004230_MYSTERYVOICE
465.description: When I was a boy, many long years ago...

466.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004240_MYSTERYVOICE
466.description: ...I yearned to stand tall as the heroes of eld.

467.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004250_MYSTERYVOICE
467.description: But like a fool seeking to pluck the stars from the heavens, my every attempt to reprise their deeds fell short...

468.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004260_MYSTERYVOICE
468.description: And then, one day, an all but forgotten dream from my youth stood before me, in the flesh.

469.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004270_MYSTERYVOICE
469.description: A hero who looked to the horizon and beyond, and saw I knew not what.

470.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004280_MYSTERYVOICE
470.description: All I knew was that I would give anything to stand at that hero's side.

471.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004290_MYSTERYVOICE
471.description: Would that it were so easy...

472.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004300_MYSTERYVOICE
472.description: The glory of the heavens was ever beyond the grasp of those who never thought to reach for it. But if I've gained anything from all of this, it is the courage to stretch out my hand.

473.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004310_MYSTERYVOICE
473.description: Do you hear me, G'raha Tia? This is no time for sleeping!

474.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004320_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
474.description: Meanwhile, in the imperial palace in the Source...

476.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004340_SHADOWHUNTER
476.description: To the west gate! I want to know what's happening there.

477.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004350_ESTINIEN
477.description: Same as the others─struck down with a single blow. An unfortunate day to draw guard duty.

478.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004360_ESTINIEN
478.description: Forgive me. These were your people.

479.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004370_SHADOWHUNTER
479.description: We took advantage of this slaughter to slip into the palace. 'Tis not for me to grieve them.

485.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004430_ZENOS
485.description: (-???-)Gaius! You've missed your part in this, I'm afraid.

487.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004450_ZENOS
487.description: You were hoping for the Ascian?

488.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004460_ZENOS
488.description: The craven shed this skin and fled rather than face me. A pity─I was looking forward to crossing blades with myself.

489.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004470_ZENOS
489.description: But I cannot deny the feeling of satisfaction...

490.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004480_ZENOS
490.description: Body and soul, reunited at last!

491.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004490_ESTINIEN
491.description: What now? The game continues, but the pieces have changed.

492.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004500_SHADOWHUNTER
492.description: Only if we trust in a paragon's words─a mistake I do not intend to repeat.

496.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004540_VARIS
496.description: Elidibus is gone... Tore a hole into the rift...

499.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004570_VARIS
499.description: Was a second life not enough? Was the Empire too rich a prize to ignore?

500.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004580_VARIS
500.description: True freedom for our nation─our people─will never be won by a spoiled princeling! The burden of this throne is beyond you.

501.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004590_ZENOS
501.description: Hmph. 'Tis you, Father, who have struggled with this burden. Simply holding the Empire together has occupied your limited faculties.

502.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004600_ZENOS
502.description: But you may take comfort in knowing that I have no intention of pursuing your tedious agenda, nor am I interested in ruling over the Empire's lands.

503.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004610_ZENOS
503.description: I came only to remove that which ruins my sport. I will not have my prey stolen by your petty wars and cowardly weapons.

504.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004620_VARIS
504.description: You would kill me just for that...?

505.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004630_ZENOS
505.description: I need no other reason. Any and all who interfere with my hunt...

508.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004660_ZENOS
508.description: I heard the Ascian speak of Zodiark and Hydaelyn. Even the will of this star is but a construct of our own making...

509.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004670_ZENOS
509.description: We shall gorge upon their strength, and then, my friend, our contest shall begin anew.

513.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004710_HYTHLODAEUS
513.description: (-???-)<hex:024804F2022303>You, I think, are from a time beyond ours. Have you followed in the wake of Emet-Selch?<hex:0248020103>

514.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004720_HYTHLODAEUS
514.description: (-???-)<hex:024804F2022303>Nay, there is no cause for alarm. I am simply a shade. Here and not here.<hex:0248020103>

515.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004730_HYTHLODAEUS
515.description: <hex:024804F2022303>I know only that my name is Hythlodaeus, and that this city is a recreation─a phantom moment plucked from the well of history.<hex:0248020103>

516.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004740_HYTHLODAEUS
516.description: <hex:024804F2022303>These others seem unaware of their pale existence, but I wonder if Emet-Selch's mind was distracted when it came to my reconstitution.<hex:0248020103>

517.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004750_HYTHLODAEUS
517.description: <hex:024804F2022303>A stray thought would have been enough. “Hythlodaeus will realize the truth,” for example. We were...close friends once, you see...<hex:0248020103>

518.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004760_HYTHLODAEUS
518.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Yet in spite of my perception, I play the same role as all the rest─a bit part, meant to bring color and noise to this well-crafted stage. Too much scrutiny, and we shall burst like the fragile bubbles we are.<hex:0248020103>

519.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004770_HYTHLODAEUS
519.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Thus I tell you again: my presence is naught to concern you. I wish only to share your company whilst we wait.<hex:0248020103>

520.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004780_HYTHLODAEUS
520.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...If you've come this far, then you know of the catastrophe which awaits us on our “morrow.”<hex:0248020103>

521.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004790_HYTHLODAEUS
521.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The Final Days. What began as isolated incidents soon swelled into a world-spanning threat...<hex:0248020103>

522.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004800_HYTHLODAEUS
522.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The Convocation of Fourteen─well, it was Thirteen at the time─endeavored to create a will for our star. They would repair the fundamental laws of order and halt the spread of destruction.<hex:0248020103>

523.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004810_HYTHLODAEUS
523.description: <hex:024804F2022303>But creation on such a scale required an immense source of power...<hex:0248020103>

524.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004820_HYTHLODAEUS
524.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Of those of us who still lived, nearly half offered up their lives in the name of salvation.<hex:0248020103>

525.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004830_HYTHLODAEUS
525.description: <hex:024804F2022303>And from their sacrifice, Zodiark was born. Just as we had hoped, He reached forth and halted the march of oblivion.<hex:0248020103>

526.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004840_HYTHLODAEUS
526.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...Yet oh how the star had suffered. So many species lost. The land was blighted, the waters poisoned, and even the wind had ceased to blow.<hex:0248020103>

527.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004850_HYTHLODAEUS
527.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Once more did our people give of themselves to Zodiark. Another half of our race sacrificed to cleanse the world; to ensure that trees and grasses and myriad tiny lives would sprout and grow and flourish.<hex:0248020103>

528.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004860_HYTHLODAEUS
528.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The cycle of life had begun anew, and we reconsidered the means by which we might protect it.<hex:0248020103>

529.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004870_HYTHLODAEUS
529.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The Convocation decided thus: we would nurture our world until it was bursting with vitality. Then, when the time was right, we would offer some portion of its living energy to Zodiark...<hex:0248020103>

530.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004880_HYTHLODAEUS
530.description: <hex:024804F2022303>In return, He would restore to us those brethren whose souls had fed His strength, and together we would resume our role as stewards.<hex:0248020103>

531.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004890_HYTHLODAEUS
531.description: <hex:024804F2022303>There were, however, those who disagreed with this plan. They argued that enough had been sacrificed to Zodiark─that this new world should belong to the lives newly born.<hex:0248020103>

532.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004900_HYTHLODAEUS
532.description: <hex:024804F2022303>These dissidents surrendered their life energies in the creation of Hydaelyn, an incarnation of their opposing belief. And for the first time in history, our people stood divided... Know you, then, how this conflict ended?<hex:0248020103>

534.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004920_HYTHLODAEUS
534.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Emet-Selch has ever been a champion for the will of Zodiark.<hex:0248020103>

535.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004930_HYTHLODAEUS
535.description: <hex:024804F2022303>The original plan may have been set back by millennia, but he will have not abandoned his course. He will pay the price for our return by whatever means is necessary.<hex:0248020103>

536.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004940_HYTHLODAEUS
536.description: <hex:024804F2022303>And though he may carry himself with a certain glib ease, Emet-Selch is not a man to bear his burdens lightly. In fact, I imagine they have only grown heavier with every passing century...<hex:0248020103>

537.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004950_HYTHLODAEUS
537.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...'Tis truly a terrible weight he has chosen to carry.<hex:0248020103>

539.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004970_HYTHLODAEUS
539.description: <hex:024804F2022303>It seems your turn has come. Pray do not let me keep you.<hex:0248020103>

540.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004980_HYTHLODAEUS
540.description: <hex:024804F2022303>...Ah, there was one last thing. You walk with another at your side, yes?<hex:0248020103>

541.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_004990_HYTHLODAEUS
541.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Nay, I see no definite form...just the faintest suggestion of a second soul. I doubt it visible to anyone but me.<hex:0248020103>

542.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_005000_HYTHLODAEUS
542.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Otherwise, I assume only <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> can see and hear this ethereal companion?<hex:0248020103>

543.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_005010_HYTHLODAEUS
543.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hm hm hm... Your connection is hardly a coincidence. In our time, the two of you were one─the color of your souls tells the tale.<hex:0248020103>

544.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_005020_HYTHLODAEUS
544.description: <hex:024804F2022303>A hue that distinctive cannot be mistaken, no matter how thin the soul is spread.<hex:0248020103>

545.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_005030_HYTHLODAEUS
545.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hah! This is just the kind of fate I might expect for one such as he. Surely Emet-Selch has recognized the hint of “him” in you...?<hex:0248020103>

546.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_005040_HYTHLODAEUS
546.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Hah! This is just the kind of fate I might expect for one such as she. Surely Emet-Selch has recognized the hint of “her” in you...?<hex:0248020103>

548.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05005_005060_HYTHLODAEUS
548.description: <hex:024804F2022303>Fare you well, my new old friend. May you find what it is you seek.<hex:0248020103>
